ORDINANCE XLI OF 2002

FOUNDATION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLI OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Frontier Education Foundation Act, 1992
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 15th October, 2002]
No.LEGIS.1(6)/91/7445, dated
15-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Frontier Education
Foundation (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 4 of N.W.F.P. Act No. III of 1992

ORDINANCE XLI OF 2002
FRONTIER EDUCATION
FOUNDATION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLI OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Frontier Education Foundation Act, 1992
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 15th October, 2002]
No.LEGIS.1(6)/91/7445, dated
15-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 4 of
N.-W.F.P. Act No. III of 1992.--In the Frontier Education Foundation Act,
1992 (N:-W.F.P. Act No. III of 1992), hereinafter referred to as the said Act,
in section 4, in sub-section (1),--
(i) for clause
(a), the following clause shall be substituted, namely:
"(a) the
Chairman, who shall be the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province:"
(ii) after
clause (d) the following new clause shall be inserted, to Government, Planning
and Development Department.
(iii) for clause
(f), the following clause shall be
substituted; namely:
"(f) three nominees of the Governor,
comprising a male and a female from an education institution belonging to
private sector and one person from a non-governmental organization other than
an educational institution;";
(iv) for clause (g), the following clause
shall be substituted, namely:
"(g) the Managing Director, Bank of
Khyber;";
(v) in clause (k), the word "and"
appearing at the end shall be deleted;
(vi) in clause (l), the full-stop appearing
at the end shall be replaced by a semicolon and thereafter the word
"and" shall be added; and
(vii) after clause (1), as so amended, the
following clause shall be added, namely:
"(m) one eminent educationist to be
nominated by the Governor."

(a)     in

"Provided
that at least one meeting shall he field after every six month." and
(b) after
subsection (1), as so amended, the following nevi sub section shall be
inserted, namely:
"(1a) Every

Amendment of section 13 of N.W.F.P. Act No. III of 1992

ORDINANCE XLI OF 2002
FRONTIER EDUCATION
FOUNDATION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLI OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Frontier Education Foundation Act, 1992
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 15th October, 2002]
No.LEGIS.1(6)/91/7445, dated
15-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
4. Amendment of section 13 of
N.-W.F.P. Act No. III of 1992. In the said Act in section 13,--
(a) in
sub-section (2),--
(i) in clause (b),
for the word "grants", the word "loan" shall be
substituted; and
(ii) after
clause (c), the following new clause shall be inserted, namely;
"(cc) grant
scholarships, stipends, fellowships to students on merit cum-inaffordability
basis; both in public and private education institutions, including those run
by autonomous bodies:":
(b) after
sub-section (2), as so amended, the following new sub section (3) shall be
added, namely: ;
"(3) The facility provided
under clause (cc) of sub-section (2), shall be distributed equally among male
arid female students belonging to urban and rural areas. The educational
institution concerned shall, in respect of every student to whom the facility
under the aforesaid provisions has been extended, allow concession in the
tuition fee to the extent of twenty percent of the total fee being charged by
such institution."

5. Amendment of section 14 of
N.-W.F.P. Act No. III of 1992.--In the said Act, in section 14, for
sub-section (1), the following shall be substituted, namely:
"(1) While making loans
under this Act, the Board may impose such conditions or execute such agreements
as it may consider necessary or expedient for protecting its interest and
securing that the loan is put to such use by the borrower for which it was
advanced."

Insertion of new section 15A to N.W.F.P. Act No. III of 1992

ORDINANCE XLI OF 2002
FRONTIER EDUCATION
FOUNDATION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLI OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Frontier Education Foundation Act, 1992
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 15th October, 2002]
No.LEGIS.1(6)/91/7445, dated
15-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:---
6. Insertion of new section
15A to N.-W.F.P. Act No. III of 1992.- In the said Act, after section 15,
the following new section shall be inserted, namely:
"15A. Endowment
Fund.--In addition to the Fund being maintained, under section 15, there
shall be established a separate fund to be known as 'Endowment Fund' to which
shall be credited grants and donations made by Government, including the
Federal Government, or any foreign agency or local organization, or by an
individual for the specific purpose of grant of scholarships, stipends,
fellow-ships, etc. to the students under clause (cc) of subsection (2) of
section 13."
